# A single comment line.

* Introduction
This paragraph shows *bold*, /italic/, ~code~, =verbatim=, _underline_, +strikethrough+, x^{2}, H_{2}O.
A forced break here:\\
and then the continuation.

See [[https://gnu.org][GNU]] or a raw link https://example.org plus a
footnote reference[fn:one] and an inline footnote[fn::like this].

* Links and images
An external [[https://example.org/docs][documentation link]], a bare [[notes.org]],
an [[file:photo.png][inline image]], a bare [[images/diagram.svg]] and a jump
[[file:notes.org::*Introduction][into another file]].
A local anchor [[#custom-id][custom id]] and a heading link [[*Introduction][up top]].
Mail [[mailto:hello@example.org][the author]] or dial [[tel:+123456]].

[fn:one] The footnote definition.
